scope: Attribute and inline-style SVG reference dependency graphs, scoped IDs, relative image resources and href precedence; not a complete implementation of PR #585

targeted.note: The shared graph test fails at its first nested dependency assertion on baseline; later assertions are candidate controls, not separately counted baseline failures.

assertions: Sibling gradients, gradient chains, nested uses, clipPath, mask and filter dependencies are copied recursively
Two external documents with the same original IDs retain separate green/blue pixels and unique imported IDs
Dependency cycles terminate; overlapping child-before-parent imports reuse one definition
Relative image with xml:base, cross-file use and feImage use existing resolver and capture cache
External use without a fragment selects the SVG document root
Modern href including an explicit empty value wins over deprecated XLink; missing image href does not fetch the page
Local and ShadowRoot out-of-subtree definitions preserve dependencies; excluded in-subtree definitions are not resurrected
Source DOM stays unchanged; a frozen snapshot ignores later source reference edits
Blue WebKit rounding and encoded special-ID output are compared to same-engine native SVG controls without widening pixel tolerance
limitations: External sibling CSS stylesheets and font dependencies have not been established
Transform-added references after clone-time resolution are not newly handled
Redirect-final-URL rebasing has not been established
PR #585 also changes filtering, live reflow, cache API and image scheduling; this fix does not transplant or resolve those requirements
The existing WebKit native iframe GC skip is unrelated

localValidation.skipReason: Inherited WebKit native iframe GC control
